settings.heading: Shipping and returns
settings.text: Every order is packed by hand in our studio, wrapped in recyclable paper and sent with tracking. If something isn't right, we make it right.

settings.title: Delivery
settings.text: Free standard delivery on orders over €60. Nordic countries in 1 to 3 working days, the rest of Europe in 2 to 5.

settings.title: Returns
settings.text: Return unopened products within 30 days for a full refund. Opened and not right for your skin? Tell us, and we'll find a solution.

settings.title: Packaging
settings.text: Glass jars, aluminium caps and paper wrapping, all recyclable. No plastic fillers, ever.

settings.question: How much does shipping cost?
settings.answer: Standard delivery is €4.90 and free on orders over €60. Express delivery to the Nordic countries is €9.90 and arrives the next working day when ordered before 14:00 CET.

settings.question: How do I return a product?
settings.answer: Contact us with your order number and we'll send you a prepaid return label. Once your parcel arrives, your refund is processed within 5 working days.

settings.question: My order arrived damaged. What now?
settings.answer: We're sorry. Send us a photo of the damaged item within 7 days and we'll ship a replacement straight away, at no cost to you.

settings.question: Will I pay customs or import fees?
settings.answer: Not within the EU. For Norway, Switzerland and the United Kingdom, any local duties are calculated and shown at checkout, so there are no surprises on delivery.

settings.heading: Questions about an order?
settings.text: Have your order number ready and we'll take care of the rest.
